extension_description.message: An extension for jut.su that allows videos to autoplay, skip anime intros, and start the next episode automatically.

next_series_before_end_description.message: Automatically start the next episode before the credits begin.

next_series_after_end_description.message: Automatically start the next episode after the credits end.

skip_intro_description.message: Automatically skip anime intros to save time.

video_from_start_description.message: Always start the video from the beginning, ignoring previous progress.

pseudo_fullscreen_description.message: Enable pseudo-fullscreen mode without switching to fullscreen.

mark_video_timeline_description.message: Show markers for intro and credits on the timeline.

click_to_fullscreen_description.message: Click on the video to enter fullscreen mode with overlay.

add_speed_control_description.message: Add a control panel to adjust video playback speed.
